statCard.name: Gladiator
statCard.artist: Gary Daniels III and Mohammed Agbadi

attacks.name: Praetor Punch
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Suppressive|: After this attack is resolved, the target character loses 1 |!power| for each |!wild| in the attack roll.

attacks.name: Eye Beam
steps: |!wild| |*Incinerate|: After this attack is resolved, the target character gains the |§incinerate§Incinerate| special condition.

attacks.name: Majestor‘s Might
steps: |!wild| |*Stagger|: After this attack is resolved, the target character gains the |§stagger§Stagger| special condition.
|!wild| |*Throw|: Before |!damage| is dealt, this character may Throw the target character Away |!range_small|.

superPowers.name: For the Empress and Empire!
superPowers.body: |*Action|: This character immediately makes a move action followed by a |*Praetor Punch| attack. If this attack deals |!damage|, this character gains 1 |<confidence>Confidence| token. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Imperial Authority
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature of Size 4 or less within |!range| 2 of this character and Throw it |!movement_large|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: The Majestor‘s Bravado
superPowers.body: When this character deals |!damage| with a |*Praetor Punch| attack, after the attack is resolved this character gains 1 |<confidence>Confidence| token. When this character suffers |!damage|, it loses 1 Confidence token. This character may have a maximum of 5 Confidence tokens at any time.|\|When this character makes an attack, it adds 1 die to the attack roll for each Confidence token it has.

superPowers.name: Alpha Strontian Physiology
superPowers.body: During the |*Power Phase|, this character gains 1 additional |!power|.
